s1101.literal: At the end of Han, Zheng Xuan took the Marquis Zhang's Discourses as his base, consulted the Qi Discourses and the Old Discourses, and annotated it.
s1101.idiomatic: At the end of Han, Zheng Xuan took the Marquis Zhang's Discourses as his base, consulted the Qi Discourses and the Old Discourses, and annotated the Analects.

s1102.literal: Chen Qun, Minister of Works of Wei, Wang Su, Grand Minister of Ceremonies, and Erudite Zhou Shengli all composed explications of meaning.
s1102.idiomatic: Chen Qun, Minister of Works of Wei, Wang Su, Grand Minister of Ceremonies, and Erudite Zhou Shengli all composed explications of meaning.

s1103.literal: He Yan, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, also composed collected explanations.
s1103.idiomatic: He Yan, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, also composed collected explanations.

s1104.literal: 是後諸儒多為之注，齊論遂亡。.
s1104.idiomatic: 是後諸儒多為之注，齊論遂亡。.

s1105.literal: 古論先無師說，梁、陳之時，唯鄭玄、何晏立于國學，而鄭氏甚微。.
s1105.idiomatic: 古論先無師說，梁、陳之時，唯鄭玄、何晏立于國學，而鄭氏甚微。.

s1106.literal: Under Zhou and Qi, the Zheng school alone was established.
s1106.idiomatic: Under Zhou and Qi, the Zheng school alone was established.

s1107.literal: By Sui, He and Zheng were both current; the Zheng school flourished among the people.
s1107.idiomatic: By Sui, He and Zheng were both current; the Zheng school flourished among the people.

s1108.literal: 其孔叢、家語，並孔氏所傳仲尼之旨。.
s1108.idiomatic: 其孔叢、家語，並孔氏所傳仲尼之旨。.

s1109.literal: 爾雅諸Documents，解古今之意，並五經總義，附於此篇。.
s1109.idiomatic: 爾雅諸Documents，解古今之意，並五經總義，附於此篇。.

s1110.literal: 經緯河圖二十卷梁河圖洛Documents二十四卷，目錄一卷，亡。.
s1110.idiomatic: 經緯河圖二十卷梁河圖洛Documents二十四卷，目錄一卷，亡。.

s1112.idiomatic: 易緯, 8 scrolls, annotated by 鄭玄.

s1114.idiomatic: Documents緯, 3 scrolls, 鄭玄注，梁六卷.

s1118.idiomatic: The Liang catalog listed ten scrolls.

s1125.idiomatic: Spring and Autumn災異, 15 scrolls, composed by 郗萌.

s1126.idiomatic: The Liang catalog listed Spring and Autumn緯, 30 scrolls, Song annotated by 均.

s1127.idiomatic: 春秋內事四卷，春秋包命二卷，春秋秘事十一卷，Documents、易、Odes、孝經、春秋、河洛緯秘要一卷，五帝鉤命訣圖一卷。.

s1129.idiomatic: Classic of Filial Piety勾命訣, 6 scrolls, Song annotated by 均.

s1130.idiomatic: Classic of Filial Piety援神契, 7 scrolls, Song annotated by 均.

s1131.literal: Classic of Filial Piety內事, 1 scroll, Liang annotated by 有《孝經雜緯》十卷，宋均.
s1131.idiomatic: Classic of Filial Piety內事, 1 scroll, Liang annotated by 有《孝經雜緯》十卷，宋均.

s1132.literal: 孝經元命包一卷，孝經古秘援神二卷，孝經古秘圖一卷，孝經左右握二卷，孝經左右契圖一卷，孝經雌雄圖三卷，孝經異本雌雄圖二卷，孝經分野圖一卷，孝經內事圖二卷，孝經內事星宿講堂七十二弟子圖一卷，又口授圖一卷；.
s1132.idiomatic: 孝經元命包一卷，孝經古秘援神二卷，孝經古秘圖一卷，孝經左右握二卷，孝經左右契圖一卷，孝經雌雄圖三卷，孝經異本雌雄圖二卷，孝經分野圖一卷，孝經內事圖二卷，孝經內事星宿講堂七十二弟子圖一卷，又口授圖一卷；.

s1134.literal: 孔老讖十二卷，老子河洛讖一卷，尹公讖四卷，劉向讖一卷，雜讖Documents二十九卷，堯戒舜、禹一卷，孔子王明鏡一卷，郭文金雄記一卷，王子年歌一卷，嵩高道士歌一卷。.
s1134.idiomatic: 孔老讖十二卷，老子河洛讖一卷，尹公讖四卷，劉向讖一卷，雜讖Documents二十九卷，堯戒舜、禹一卷，孔子王明鏡一卷，郭文金雄記一卷，王子年歌一卷，嵩高道士歌一卷。.

s1136.literal: Above: 十三部，合九十二卷.
s1136.idiomatic: Above: 十三部，合九十二卷.

s1137.literal: Counting lost books together, 三十二部 titles, 共二百三十二卷 scrolls.
s1137.idiomatic: Including lost books, totaling 三十二部 titles and 共二百三十二卷 scrolls.

s1139.literal: Thus when the sage receives the Mandate, he must build on accumulated virtue and repeated achievement, abundant merit and thick benefit, sincerity manifest to Heaven and Earth and grace covering the living—what the myriad things turn toward and what the spirits bless—then there is a response of the Heavenly Mandate.
s1139.idiomatic: Thus when the sage receives the Mandate, he must build on accumulated virtue and repeated achievement, abundant merit and thick benefit, sincerity manifest to Heaven and Earth and grace covering the living—what the myriad things turn toward and what the spirits bless—then there is a response of the Heavenly Mandate.

s1140.literal: Tortoises and dragons bear and carry them, emerging from the River and Luo, to record signs of dynastic change; the principle is obscure and reaches to the spirit-way.
s1140.idiomatic: Tortoises and dragons bear and carry them, emerging from the River and Luo, to record signs of dynastic change; the principle is obscure and reaches to the spirit-way.

s1141.literal: The earlier kings feared they would confuse people and kept them secret without transmitting them.
s1141.idiomatic: The earlier kings feared they would confuse people and kept them secret without transmitting them.

s1142.literal: Expositors also say that after Confucius had arranged the Six Classics to clarify the Way of Heaven and man, knowing later generations could not examine together his intent, he separately established weft texts and prognostications to leave them to posterity.
s1142.idiomatic: Expositors also say that after Confucius had arranged the Six Classics to clarify the Way of Heaven and man, knowing later generations could not examine together his intent, he separately established weft texts and prognostications to leave them to posterity.

s1143.literal: 其Documents出於前漢，有河圖九篇，洛Documents六篇，雲自黃帝至周文王所受本文。.
s1143.idiomatic: 其Documents出於前漢，有河圖九篇，洛Documents六篇，雲自黃帝至周文王所受本文。.

s1144.literal: There are also thirty chapters, said to have been expanded by the nine sages from the beginning down to Confucius to broaden the meaning.
s1144.idiomatic: There are also thirty chapters, said to have been expanded by the nine sages from the beginning down to Confucius to broaden the meaning.

s1145.literal: There was also 七經緯, 三十六篇，並雲孔子所作，並前合為八十一篇.
s1145.idiomatic: There was also 七經緯, 三十六篇，並雲孔子所作，並前合為八十一篇.

s1146.literal: 而又有Documents中候、洛罪級、五行傳、Odes推度災、氾曆樞、含神務、孝經勾命訣、援神契、雜讖等Documents。.
s1146.idiomatic: 而又有Documents中候、洛罪級、五行傳、Odes推度災、氾曆樞、含神務、孝經勾命訣、援神契、雜讖等Documents。.

s1147.literal: In Han there were the Xi and Yuan schools of exposition.
s1147.idiomatic: In Han there were the Xi and Yuan schools of exposition.

s1148.literal: 漢末，郎中郗萌集圖緯讖雜占為五十篇，謂之春秋災異。.
s1148.idiomatic: 漢末，郎中郗萌集圖緯讖雜占為五十篇，謂之春秋災異。.

s1149.literal: Song Jun and Zheng Xuan both composed annotations on prognostications and statutes.
s1149.idiomatic: Song Jun and Zheng Xuan both composed annotations on prognostications and statutes.

s1150.literal: Yet their literary phrasing is shallow and vulgar, inverted and erroneous, not resembling the purport of the sages.
s1150.idiomatic: Yet their literary phrasing is shallow and vulgar, inverted and erroneous, not resembling the purport of the sages.

s1151.literal: Transmission suggests that after people of the world fabricated them, some perhaps further altered them—it is not a true record.
s1151.idiomatic: Transmission suggests that after people of the world fabricated them, some perhaps further altered them—it is not a true record.

s1152.literal: It began when Wang Mang loved token-destiny; Emperor Guangwu rose through charts and prognostications, and thus it greatly flourished in the world.
s1152.idiomatic: It began when Wang Mang loved token-destiny; Emperor Guangwu rose through charts and prognostications, and thus it greatly flourished in the world.

s1153.literal: In Han an edict also ordered King Cang of Dongping to correct the commentarial glosses of the Five Classics—all were commanded to follow prognostications.
s1153.idiomatic: In Han an edict also ordered King Cang of Dongping to correct the commentarial glosses of the Five Classics—all were commanded to follow prognostications.

s1154.literal: Vulgar Confucians chased the times and further made it their learning; scrolls and titles grew ever more numerous.
s1154.idiomatic: Vulgar Confucians chased the times and further made it their learning; scrolls and titles grew ever more numerous.

s1155.literal: Those who spoke of the Five Classics all relied on prognostications as their explanation.
s1155.idiomatic: Those who spoke of the Five Classics all relied on prognostications as their explanation.

s1156.literal: Only Kong Anguo, Lord Mao, Wang Huang, Jia Kui, and the like rejected it, transmitting the view that it was delusive and false, disordering the canonical mean.
s1156.idiomatic: Only Kong Anguo, Lord Mao, Wang Huang, Jia Kui, and the like rejected it, transmitting the view that it was delusive and false, disordering the canonical mean.

s1157.literal: Therefore, relying on the ancient script obtained by King Gong of Lu and King Xian of Hejian in Han, they collated and examined it to complete its meaning—this was called "ancient learning."
s1157.idiomatic: Therefore, relying on the ancient script obtained by King Gong of Lu and King Xian of Hejian in Han, they collated and examined it to complete its meaning—this was called "ancient learning."

s1158.literal: Confucian scholars of the age also denounced and destroyed it; in the end it could not be established.
s1158.idiomatic: Confucian scholars of the age also denounced and destroyed it; in the end it could not be established.

s1159.literal: Wang Su of Wei promoted ancient learning to challenge its meaning.
s1159.idiomatic: Wang Su of Wei promoted ancient learning to challenge its meaning.

s1160.literal: Wang Bi and Du Yu followed and clarified it; from this ancient learning was gradually established.
s1160.idiomatic: Wang Bi and Du Yu followed and clarified it; from this ancient learning was gradually established.

s1161.literal: By the Daming era of Song, charts and prognostications were first banned; after the Tianjian era of Liang the prohibition was renewed.
s1161.idiomatic: By the Daming era of Song, charts and prognostications were first banned; after the Tianjian era of Liang the prohibition was renewed.

s1162.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, the ban was even stricter.
s1162.idiomatic: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, the ban was even stricter.

s1163.literal: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, he sent emissaries in four directions to search books throughout the realm; whatever was connected with prognostications and weft texts was burned; those reported by officials were punished by death.
s1163.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, he sent emissaries in four directions to search books throughout the realm; whatever was connected with prognostications and weft texts was burned; those reported by officials were punished by death.

s1164.literal: From this the learning no longer existed; within the secret repository much was also lost and scattered.
s1164.idiomatic: From this the learning no longer existed; within the secret repository much was also lost and scattered.

s1165.literal: Now what survives in writing is recorded and listed under the Six Classics to preserve variant doctrines.
s1165.idiomatic: Now what survives in writing is recorded and listed under the Six Classics to preserve variant doctrines.

s1167.literal: 秦相李斯作蒼頡篇，漢揚雄作訓纂篇，後漢郎中賈魴作滂喜篇，故曰三蒼。.
s1167.idiomatic: 秦相李斯作蒼頡篇，漢揚雄作訓纂篇，後漢郎中賈魴作滂喜篇，故曰三蒼。.
